# Community Code of Conduct

We welcome participation from everyone. Be respectful, assume good intent,
and keep criticism focused on ideas and work. Harassment, discrimination,
threats, and personal attacks are not acceptable.

Project maintainers may remove content or restrict participation when needed
to keep the community safe and constructive. Report conduct concerns to the
project maintainers at [casjay@yahoo.com](mailto:casjay@yahoo.com).
